header.title: How to Clean Your Washing Machine
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to thoroughly clean your washing machine, removing residue and odors for optimal performance. It utilizes a combination of vinegar, baking soda, and manual cleaning techniques.

steps.description: Fill the washing machine basin with hot water using the hottest water temperature and longest cycle.
actions: Turn the washing machine on
Select the hottest water temperature
Select the longest cycle

steps.description: Add 2 to 4 cups of white vinegar to the washer filled with water and let it sit for 30-60 minutes.
actions: Fill the washer with water
Add 2 to 4 cups of white vinegar
Let the solution sit in the washer for 30 minutes to an hour
Pour vinegar or bleach into the dispenser (if available)
Run a cycle with vinegar (for front loaders)

steps.description: After agitating the vinegar, add baking soda to the mix and allow the solution to sit for 30 minutes to loosen dirt and grime.
actions: Allow the vinegar to agitate for a few minutes.
Open the lid.
Add about a cup of baking soda to the mix.
Stop the washer (if possible).
Allow the solution to sit for 30 minutes.

steps.description: While the cleaning solution works, remove removable parts and clean the exterior of the washing machine.
actions: Remove any loose parts, like fabric softener dispensers
Place removed parts in a soapy solution
Clean fabric softener dispensers with an old toothbrush
Clean the space along the top of the agitator with an old toothbrush
Clean any other accessible areas with an old toothbrush
Clean the outside of the machine
steps.part: Fabric softener dispensers, agitator, exterior of the machine

steps.description: Start the washing machine cycle after the cleaning solution has soaked for 30 minutes and clean the machine's surfaces with vinegar and water or bleach.
actions: Close the lid
Start the cycle
Clean the lid
Clean the top console
Clean the dials

steps.description: Run a second washing machine cycle with 2 to 4 cups of vinegar to remove remaining grime.
actions: Run another cycle
Add 2 to 4 cups of vinegar
Hit the center agitator with a cleaning cloth (optional)

steps.description: Clean the washing machine basin with a microfiber cloth, optionally using a vinegar solution to remove stubborn stains.
actions: Clean away the last bits of residue
Use a vinegar solution to remove stubborn stains
Replace any parts you removed
Run a short cycle to filter any remaining vinegar
